name: Oficina Mecânica — Operação
description: Painéis exigidos na Fase 3: volume diário de OS, tempo médio por status, erros de integração, latência das APIs, recursos do Kubernetes e uptime. Substitua ACCOUNT_ID_AQUI pelo Account ID numérico antes de importar.

pages.name: Ordens de serviço
pages.description: Volume, tempo por status e falhas de integração

widgets.title: Volume diário de ordens de serviço

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'os_criada' TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'os_criada' SINCE 7 days ago COMPARE WITH 7 days ago
SELECT average(duracaoNoStatusAnteriorMs) / 3600000 AS 'Horas' FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'os_status_alterado' FACET statusAnterior SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Tempo por status ao longo do tempo

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(duracaoNoStatusAnteriorMs) / 3600000 FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'os_status_alterado' AND statusAnterior IN ('EM_DIAGNOSTICO', 'EM_EXECUCAO', 'FINALIZADA') FACET statusAnterior TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT percentile(duracaoNoStatusAnteriorMs / 3600000, 50, 90, 99) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'os_status_alterado' FACET statusAnterior SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'os_status_alterado' FACET statusAnterior, statusNovo SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'falha_integracao' FACET integracao, operacao TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT timestamp, integracao, operacao, numeroOS, erro, reqId FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'falha_integracao' SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 50

pages.name: APIs e latência
pages.description: Latência, throughput e erros do gateway e da aplicação

widgets.title: Latência da API (p50 / p95 / p99, ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 95, 99) * 1000 FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api' TIMESERIES SINCE 6 hours ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE aws.logGroup LIKE '/aws/apigateway/oficina%' FACET cases(WHERE numeric(status) < 300 AS '2xx', WHERE numeric(status) < 400 AS '3xx', WHERE numeric(status) < 500 AS '4xx', WHERE numeric(status) >= 500 AS '5xx') TIMESERIES SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT average(duration) * 1000 AS 'ms médio', count(*) AS 'chamadas' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api' FACET name SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Latência no API Gateway por rota

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(numeric(latenciaMs)), percentile(numeric(latenciaMs), 95) FROM Log WHERE aws.logGroup LIKE '/aws/apigateway/oficina%' FACET routeKey TIMESERIES SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'erro_interno' FACET rota TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Acessos negados pelo guard de autorização

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'acesso_negado' FACET motivo TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-auth-lambda' AND message = 'autenticação por CPF concluída' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-auth-lambda' AND level = 'warn' FACET message SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duracaoMs), percentile(duracaoMs, 95, 99) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-auth-lambda' AND duracaoMs IS NOT NULL TIMESERIES SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-auth-lambda' AND level = 'error' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

pages.name: Kubernetes e uptime
pages.description: Consumo de recursos, autoscaling e disponibilidade

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(cpuUsedCores / cpuLimitCores) * 100 AS 'CPU %' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE containerName = 'oficina-api' TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago
SELECT average(memoryWorkingSetBytes) / 1048576 AS 'MB' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE containerName = 'oficina-api' FACET podName TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago
SELECT latest(podsDesired), latest(podsReady) FROM K8sReplicasetSample WHERE deploymentName = 'oficina-api' TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago
SELECT average(allocatableCpuCoresUtilization), average(allocatableMemoryUtilization) FROM K8sNodeSample FACET nodeName TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result = 'SUCCESS') AS 'Uptime %' FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE monitorName = 'oficina-api-health' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND evento = 'readiness_falhou' FACET dependencia TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(restartCount) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE containerName = 'oficina-api' FACET podName SINCE 24 hours ago
